description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layer groupings of the Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct model under Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning using SnapKV. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer' and is divided into five categorical bins: 'Layer1-4', 'Layer5-12', 'Layer13-20', 'Layer21-28', and 'Layer29-32', representing distinct ranges of model layers. The y-axis is labeled 'Relative Change' and spans from -25% to 5% in linear increments, with tick marks every 5 percentage points. Four distinct lines are plotted: the yellow line, representing 'LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit', starts near 0%, dips slightly to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, and returns to near 0% by Layer29-32; the red line, 'LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit', begins near 0%, dips to -10% at Layer13-20, and recovers to near 0% by Layer29-32; the light blue line, 'RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit', starts at -2%, plunges to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32; and the dark blue line, 'RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit', begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. A gray dashed line, labeled 'Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit', remains constant at 0% across all layer groups, serving as a reference point.
caption_used: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as the pruning method, are shown. The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
